final: WITH pair_counts AS (SELECT tr.transreg, t.tradekind, COUNT(DISTINCT tr.transreg) AS transaction_count FROM advancedbehavior AS ab JOIN transactionrecord AS tr ON ab.translink = tr.transreg JOIN trader AS t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg GROUP BY tr.transreg, t.tradekind), total AS (SELECT SUM(transaction_count) AS total_count FROM pair_counts) SELECT p.tradekind, AVG(p.transaction_count) AS average_count_per_pair, AVG(1.0 * p.transaction_count / total.total_count) AS average_share_per_pair FROM pair_counts AS p CROSS JOIN total GROUP BY p.tradekind
